description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
60 Piece Set
Variety of Sizes for all Requirements
Attaches Door Panels, Fender Flares, Rocker Trim, Carpet Clips, Bumper Clips and Other Parts.
INCLUDES the Front & Rear Bumper End Cap Clips.
What Will I Receive?
Qty – Description – Color – Head Dia. x Shaft Diameter (Open/Closed) x Shaft Length
Qty 6 – Push Pin Gray 17mm x 7mm / 10mm x 11mm
Qty 6 – Push Pin Gray 14mm x 7mm / 9mm x 9mm
Qty 6 – Push Pin Gray 16mm x 6.5mm / 11mm x 12mm
Qty 6 – Push Pin Black 13mm x 5.5mm / 6.5mm x 8mm
Qty 6 – Push Pin Black 13.5mm x 6mm / 8mm x 18mm
Qty 10 – Metal Slip-On Screw Grommet
Qty 8 – Door Panel Installation Clips (Comes with Both Pieces – Panel & Door)
Qty 8 – Carpet Clips
Qty 4 – Bumper Cap Clips
What Vehicles Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1986 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
